# Designing Static Search with Pagefind

This is fixture content for schema validation. It contains headings, a paragraph, and a code example.

## Why static search

Static sites are fast because they ship no server. Pagefind indexes the built HTML and ships as a browser bundle.

```ts
import * as pagefind from '/pagefind/pagefind.js';
```

No server required.
